title: Tech Note: Custom Shadow for Object Focus
author: Add Komoncharoensiri, Director of Technical Services, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Gradient picture assets for shadow rendering

historical_commentary.text: This picture-composited shadow technique for classic 4D forms still works today since it relies on basic picture objects and methods, but it is a workaround for a lack of native drop-shadow/elevation styling; modern 4D form object styling (and especially web-based Qodly/HTML front-ends with CSS box-shadow) make this manual approach largely unnecessary now.
